profile.campus: Lumen / Level 3 Texas Triangle (Dallas / Austin / San Antonio)
profile.reading:
This Lumen colocation facility, internally identified in public records as Austin 1, is located at 4207-4209 Smith School Road, Austin, TX 78744, in Travis County; Lumen does not publish individual building addresses or specs on its own site for any of its 175-plus North American colocation sites. Lumen Technologies, formerly CenturyLink (renamed Lumen on September 14, 2020, with its stock ticker changing from CTL to LUMN on September 18, 2020) and built in part on CenturyLink's November 1, 2017 acquisition of Level 3 Communications, operates this facility as part of a network-centric edge colocation product rather than a wholesale hyperscale campus. Lumen's own colocation data sheet states more than 175 carrier-neutral data centers across more than 60 North American markets, offering cabinet power in the 3 to 15 kilowatt range described as varying by site; unlike the wholesale operators tracked elsewhere in this registry, Lumen does not disclose per-building square footage or total MW capacity for any of its sites.

Texas's data center sales tax exemption cost the state roughly $5-30 million a year from 2014 through 2022, jumped to more than $150 million in 2023, and is now projected at $1.3 billion for the current fiscal year, $3.2 billion over 2026-2028, and nearly $1.8 billion annually by fiscal 2030, according to the Texas Tribune. Separately, ERCOT's interconnection queue holds roughly 474 gigawatts of pending requests, more than five times the grid's record peak demand, with Governor Abbott stating about 90% of new power requests are data centers; Abbott ordered an audit of queued data centers in August 2026, and ERCOT sought a delay of its transmission planning study from the Public Utility Commission the same month.

Austin's data center growth has drawn both wholesale hyperscale campuses and smaller network-edge colocation buildings like this one, reflecting the city's position as a major Texas tech hub alongside Dallas-Fort Worth and San Antonio.

reading.body:
Lumen Austin 1 has no published power specification, making its capacity for AI workloads unknowable from operator disclosures. The facility is located at 4207 Smith School Road in Travis County, Texas, a site confirmed by two independent aggregator sources. Without published megawatts, total IT load, cooling capacity, or datacenter specifications, the campus cannot be ranked among peers or assessed against grid constraints in this state.

Texas has 18 data center campuses with published power figures totaling 468 megawatts across 133 mapped facilities statewide. Lumen Austin 1 does not appear in the published capacity rankings, placing it outside the top 18 by disclosed specifications. The operator's own specification pages contain no power disclosure for this site.

A reader evaluating AI infrastructure expansion against grid limits cannot use this campus in their analysis. Published capacity is the entry requirement for assessing whether a facility matters to compute scaling. Until Lumen Technologies discloses power specifications for Austin 1, the site remains dark to capacity planning for AI.
